question: Among the following rivers which is NOT a tributary of the Indus river system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kosi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kosi**

 
 
• This river system consists of seven different streams and is collectively addressed as Sapta Koshi. 
 
• It is a transboundary river that runs through some parts of **Bihar** and **Nepal**.
